bull.b: Durable three-year clinical and immune responses strengthen EVX-01’s evidence base beyond an early data point. Sustained benefit can improve the program’s credibility with clinicians and partners, while supporting Evaxion’s positioning in personalized oncology and potential future commercialization.

Expansion into autoimmune disease broadens the potential addressable opportunity beyond oncology and infectious disease. Testing two distinct treatment concepts also provides additional avenues to demonstrate platform versatility, attract partnerships, and create future programs from the same AI-enabled discovery capabilities.

Positive equity and lower debt represent a meaningful improvement in financial resilience compared with prior years. Combined with management’s reported runway into the second half of 2027, the stronger capital position gives Evaxion more time to advance clinical and preclinical programs before requiring additional financing.

bear.t: Persistent losses and absent recurring revenue
bear.b: Evaxion remains dependent on research progress rather than recurring product sales, with continuing operating and net losses. Without an approved commercial product or stable revenue base, the company has limited internal funding capacity and its longer-term financial profile remains tied to clinical success, partnerships, or new capital.

bear.t: Negative cash generation and financing dependence
bear.b: Ongoing negative operating and free cash flow means Evaxion is not yet self-funding its pipeline. Continued burn increases reliance on equity financing, ATM activity, or partnerships, creating potential dilution and reducing flexibility if development spending rises or external funding becomes less available.

Key pipeline expansion depends on milestones that have not yet been completed, including lead selection, IND-enabling studies, and eventual clinical entry. Delays or unfavorable results could postpone value creation and leave the company reliant on its more advanced programs for meaningful development progress.
